payload.title: Define the card variants and the grid patterns
payload.description:
The building blocks for every page.
- Card variants: feature (largest image, headline over or under it), standard (image on top), compact row (small image to the right of the text, for phones), and text-only (no image).
- Grid patterns, each adding up to the same count at every width: the 7-group (2-3-2 portrait, 3-4 landscape, 1 plus compact rows on a phone), the 1+N list (a feature, then 2 or 3 columns), and the text-only grid (2 or 3 columns).
- Narrow gaps and page margins, with padding inside cards keeping text apart. Shared rows inside a grid keep their parts aligned, as now.
- Breakpoints for phone, iPad portrait, iPad landscape, desktop and wide.
Done when the patterns render with real content in the preview at every size and Ryan approves them from screenshots.
